events.title: Emily Day & The Cosmo Alleycats
events.blurb: Hear Emily Day & The Cosmo Alleycats perform live at the San Jose Jazz Venue on Friday night.

events.title: SJZ Break Room Jazz Jam
events.blurb: Drop in to hear jazz musicians jam live at San Jose Jazz Venue's Break Room.

events.title: HSAS Big Band / U19s at Christmas in the Park
events.description: The San Jose Jazz High School All Stars Big Band and SJZ U19s perform holiday music at Christmas in the Park.
events.blurb: Hear the HSAS Big Band and SJZ U19s play holiday music at Plaza de César Chávez; admission is free.

events.title: Buy or Renew In-Person, Get Cookie Cutters Free
events.address: 201 S Market St, San Jose, CA 95113
events.blurb: Buy or renew a membership in person at The Tech Interactive and pick up free cookie cutters with it.

events.title: Tween Writing Workshop (Grades 5-8): How to Get Your Writing Published
events.description: Join Santa Clara County Youth Poet Laureate and multiple-time Scholastic Art & Writing Awards National Gold Medalist Sierra Elman in "How to Get Your Writing Published." In this one-time workshop, middle schoolers will have the opportunity to learn about youth creative writing competitions and literary publications, get tips on writing and revising both in general and specific to competitions (including the Scholastic Art & Writing Awards) and get a chance to do some writing. This workshop is open to grades 5-8 only. This workshop will be rescheduled to another day - TBD.
events.blurb: Learn from Youth Poet Laureate Sierra Elman how to get your writing published, in a workshop for grades 5-8.

events.title: Medicare Annual Enrollment and Updates 2027 Workshop
events.address: Social Hall, Mountain View Senior Center, 266 Escuela Ave., Mountain View, CA 94040
events.description: Overview of the Medicare Annual Enrollment Period, covering Medicare Advantage plans, Part D drug coverage, plan changes for the coming year, and ways to lower healthcare costs. Ages 55+ welcome. Sign up in advance.
events.blurb: Learn how Medicare Advantage, Part D coverage and plan changes work for the coming year, plus ways to lower healthcare costs.

events.title: Advance Care Planning Workshop
events.address: Social Hall, Mountain View Senior Center, 266 Escuela Ave., Mountain View, CA 94040
events.description: Workshop on advance care planning, sharing your wishes with loved ones, legal end-of-life options, and available resources. Ages 55+ welcome. Sign up in advance by phone, email or in person.
events.blurb: Learn how to plan ahead for end-of-life care, share your wishes with loved ones, and find legal options and resources.

events.title: Google Translate and Digital Emergency Prep Workshop
events.address: Social Hall, Mountain View Senior Center, 266 Escuela Ave., Mountain View, CA 94040
events.description: Learn to use Google Translate for text, websites and speech, plus smartphone features that help with safety during emergencies. Ages 55+ welcome. Sign up in advance.
events.blurb: Learn to use Google Translate for text, websites and speech, plus phone features that help keep you safe in emergencies.

events.title: Let's Work! Quarry Park Clean-Up
events.description: Volunteer workday kicking off the winter Let's Work! Program, removing non-native invasive plants from Quarry Park. Volunteers must be 15+ or ages 10-14 with an adult, and registration is required.
events.blurb: Pull non-native invasive plants from Quarry Park with fellow volunteers; registration is required, and ages 10-14 need an adult.

events.title: Puzzle Swap
events.address: Lobby, Mountain View Senior Center, 266 Escuela Ave., Mountain View, CA 94040
events.description: Bring a puzzle or two and swap them for puzzles from the Senior Center at no charge. No registration needed.
events.blurb: Swap a puzzle or two from home for new ones in the Mountain View Senior Center lobby, no registration needed.

events.title: Holiday Bazaar
events.address: Mountain View Senior Center, 266 Escuela Ave., Mountain View, CA 94040
events.description: Annual holiday craft fair with over 40 vendors selling handmade jewelry, art, knitwear and more. Also features live local entertainment, a DIY craft station and a raffle. Free and open to all ages, and most vendors accept cash only.
events.blurb: Shop over 40 vendors for handmade jewelry, art and knitwear, then try the DIY craft station, catch live music and enter the raffle.

events.title: Should I Start a Business? presented by SCORE Silicon Valley
events.address: Central Park Library - Board Room, 2635 Homestead Rd., Santa Clara, CA 95051
events.description: A SCORE Silicon Valley mentor-supported session on the fundamentals of starting a business. Topics include personal readiness, employee vs. Owner trade-offs, business options, and business plan basics.
events.blurb: Learn the fundamentals of starting a business from a SCORE mentor, including personal readiness, business options and business plan basics.

events.title: Halloween Trick-or-Treat at the Downtown Palo Alto Farmers' Market
events.venue: Gilman Street between Hamilton and Forest
events.address: Gilman Street between Hamilton and Forest, Palo Alto
events.description: Halloween celebration at the weekly farmers' market with decorations, pumpkins, and a guess-how-many-creepy-crawlies competition. Kids can complete a Halloween scavenger hunt to win a prize; live music by Gaby Castro starts at 9:30 AM.
events.blurb: Trick-or-treat through the farmers' market, hunt for Halloween scavenger prizes, guess the creepy-crawlies count and hear Gaby Castro play live at 9:30.
